# What's new in Azure DevOps docs

Welcome to what's new in the Azure DevOps docs. The following sections provide details on the previous three months of new and updated content.

*The following what's new content was generated by Copilot. Copilot is powered by AI, so surprises and mistakes are possible. For more information, see [Copilot general use FAQs](https://aka.ms/copilot-general-use-faqs).*

## August 2026

## Highlights

### New features

- [Authentication guidance for Azure DevOps](/azure/devops/organizations/security/authentication-guidance) — New guidance for choosing and implementing authentication methods in Azure DevOps.
- [Configure Copilot code review instructions](/azure/devops/repos/git/configure-copilot-code-review-instructions) — New guidance for customizing Copilot code reviews with repository instructions.
- [Troubleshoot Copilot code review](/azure/devops/repos/git/copilot-code-reviews-faq) — New troubleshooting guidance and answers to common questions about Copilot code review.
- [Optimize repository performance](/azure/devops/repos/git/optimize-repository-performance) — New guidance for improving Git repository performance.

### Other notable updates

- [Collect and provide stakeholder feedback](/azure/devops/test/request-stakeholder-feedback) — Major refresh of stakeholder feedback guidance.
- [Get started with Copilot code review for pull requests](/azure/devops/repos/git/copilot-code-reviews) — Major update to Copilot code review guidance.
- [Set Git repository permissions](/azure/devops/repos/git/set-git-repository-permissions) — Major refresh of Git repository permission guidance.
- [Configure networking](/azure/devops/managed-devops-pools/configure-networking) — Significant update to Managed DevOps Pools networking guidance.
- [Run a self-hosted agent in Docker](/azure/devops/pipelines/agents/docker) — Significant update to guidance for running self-hosted agents in Docker.
- [Set up the remote Azure DevOps MCP Server](/azure/devops/mcp-server/remote-mcp-server) — Significant update to remote Azure DevOps MCP Server setup guidance.

### Reference updates

- [InstallSSHKey@0 - Install SSH key v0 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/install-ssh-key-v0) — Updates the `knownHostsEntry` input help to show how to retrieve the known-hosts entry by running `ssh-keyscan ssh.dev.azure.com` in Git Bash.
- [UseDotNet@2 - Use dotnet v2 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/use-dotnet-v2) — Updates the `useGlobalJson` input help to document `sdk.rollForward` behavior, including exact-version fallback and supported roll-forward policies.
- [VSTest@2 - Visual Studio Test v2 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/vstest-v2) — Updates the `overrideTestrunParameters` input help to require space-separated key-value pairs and YAML folded style for multiline values.
- [AzureStaticWebApp@0 - Deploy Azure Static Web App v0 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/azure-static-web-app-v0) — Updates the `output_location` input help to clarify that the compiled application path is relative to `app_location`.

## July 2026

### Highlights

### New features

- [Search Git commits by message content](/azure/devops/project/search/functional-commit-search) — New guidance for finding Git commits by their message content.
- [Available pull request status checks](/azure/devops/repos/git/available-pr-status-checks) — New reference for pull request status checks.

### Other notable updates

- [Secure repositories and pull requests](/azure/devops/repos/git/secure-repositories-pull-requests) — New comprehensive guidance for securing repositories and pull requests.
- [Optimize permissions for performance](/azure/devops/organizations/security/permission-performance-recommendations) — New recommendations for configuring permissions to improve performance.
- [Query fields, operators, macros, and variables](/azure/devops/boards/queries/query-operators-variables) — Major update to the query fields, operators, macros, and variables reference.
- [Use personal access tokens](/azure/devops/organizations/accounts/use-personal-access-tokens-to-authenticate) — Major update to personal access token guidance.
- [Set and manage branch policies](/azure/devops/repos/git/branch-policies) — Significant update to branch policy guidance.
- [Bulk Modify Azure Boards Work Items with Excel](/azure/devops/boards/backlogs/office/bulk-add-modify-work-items-excel) — Significant update to bulk work item editing guidance for Excel.

### Reference updates

- [GradleAuthenticate@0 - Gradle Authenticate v0 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/gradle-authenticate-v0) — Adds a task that authenticates Gradle builds with Azure Artifacts feeds by using the `buildFiles`, `repositoryUrl`, `adoServiceConnection`, `pluginToolVersion`, and `gradleUserHome` inputs.
- [InvokeRESTAPI@1 - Invoke REST API v1 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/invoke-rest-api-v1) — Adds `connectedServiceNameAzureDevOps` as a `connectionType` value and the `azureDevOpsServiceConnection` input for invoking Azure DevOps REST APIs.
- [SSH@0 - SSH v0 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/ssh-v0) — Adds the `enableRemoteVsoCommands` input, which defaults to `false`, to control whether logging commands in remote output are executed.
- [PowerShellOnTargetMachines@1 - PowerShell on Target Machines v1 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/powershell-on-target-machines-v1) — Deprecated. Use [PowerShellOnTargetMachines@3](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/powershell-on-target-machines-v3) instead.

### Highlights

### New features

- [Introduction to Enterprise Live Migrations (ELM)](/azure/devops/repos/enterprise-live-migrations/overview) — New documentation set introducing Enterprise Live Migrations (ELM) from Azure DevOps to GitHub.
- [Get started with Copilot code review for pull requests](/azure/devops/repos/git/copilot-code-reviews) — New guidance on using Copilot to review pull requests in Azure Repos.
- [Copilot Autofix for code scanning in GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps (Preview)](/azure/devops/repos/security/github-advanced-security-code-scanning-autofix) — New article introducing Copilot Autofix for code scanning alerts.
- [Agent software version 5](/azure/devops/pipelines/agents/v5-agent) — New reference for the v5 pipeline agent.
- [GitHub-hosted agents for Azure Pipelines (pay-as-you-go)](/azure/devops/pipelines/agents/github-hosted) — New article covering pay-as-you-go GitHub-hosted agents for Azure Pipelines.
- [Convert service connections from the Azure DevOps issuer to the Microsoft Entra issuer](/azure/devops/pipelines/release/convert-service-connections) — New guidance for migrating workload identity service connections to the Microsoft Entra issuer.

### Other notable updates

- [Use backlogs to manage projects](/azure/devops/boards/backlogs/backlogs-overview) — Major refresh of backlog management guidance.
- [Default processes and process templates](/azure/devops/boards/work-items/guidance/choose-process) — Significant revisions to default processes and process templates.
- [Review and comment on pull requests](/azure/devops/repos/git/review-pull-requests) — Substantial updates to pull request review guidance.
- [Configure and pay for parallel jobs](/azure/devops/pipelines/licensing/concurrent-jobs) — Major updates to parallel jobs configuration and billing.

### Reference updates

- [AdvancedSecurity-Codeql-Init@1 - Advanced Security Initialize CodeQL v1 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/advanced-security-codeql-init-v1) — Adds the `cleanupOldAutomaticInstalls` input to remove older automatically installed CodeQL versions when `enableAutomaticCodeQLInstall` is enabled.
- [IISWebAppManagementOnMachineGroup@0 - IIS web app manage v0 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/iisweb-app-management-on-machine-group-v0) — Removes the invalid `Protocol`, `IPAddress`, `Port`, `ServerNameIndication`, `HostNameWithOutSNI`, `HostNameWithHttp`, `HostNameWithSNI`, and `SSLCertThumbPrint` inputs.
- [NuGetCommand@2 - NuGet v2 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/nuget-command-v2) — Adds the `requestTimeout` input to set the package publishing timeout in seconds.
- [UseNode@1 - Use Node.js ecosystem v1 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/use-node-v1) — Adds the `nodejsMirror` input to select an alternative source for Node.js binaries.
- [ContainerStructureTest@0 - Container Structure Test v0 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/container-structure-test-v0) — Deprecated.
- [PowerShellOnTargetMachines@2 - PowerShell on Target Machines v2 task](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/powershell-on-target-machines-v2) — Deprecated. Use [PowerShellOnTargetMachines@3](/azure/devops/pipelines/tasks/reference/powershell-on-target-machines-v3) instead.
